item.title: Cycle 1 · Initiating Epistemological Inquiry on Belief Justification
item.description:
This cycle begins a project focused on the epistemology of belief justification under conditions of uncertainty and noisy evidence. We are prioritizing the current attention directive by launching a project to explore how distinct philosophical frameworks—such as Bayesianism, Reliabilism, and Evidentialism—address the challenges of forming justified beliefs when data is filtered through imperfect observers or incomplete information.
